overview.name: Colombo Logistics Complex
overview.description: Colombo Logistics Complex is a regional multi-building supply chain campus featuring 7 specialized facilities: Automated High-Bay Hub (BLD-01), Bulk Distribution (BLD-02), Cleanroom Tech Mezzanine (BLD-03), Pharma Cold-Chain Vault (BLD-04), Quarantine Yard (BLD-05), MHE Fleet Depot (BLD-06), and Security Gatehouse & 60T Scale (BLD-07).

buildings.name: Building 1 — High-Bay Hub
buildings.title: 1 · High-Bay Hub
buildings.description: Building 1 (High-Bay Hub) is an automated narrow-aisle pallet high-bay facility with 2,400 pallet bays, 150 active stored lots, and high-density racking. Operates FL-01 and RT-01 with automatic guide-wire retrieval and barcode scanning.
buildings.safety_notes: Speed limit strictly 5 mph in aisles. Pedestrians must wear high-vis vests and keep to green marked walkways.

buildings.name: Building 2 — Bulk Distribution
buildings.title: 2 · Bulk Distribution
buildings.description: Building 2 (Bulk Distribution) manages bulk palletized freight, cross-dock consolidation, and high-velocity trailer outbound dispatch with 1,600 pallet bays and 95 active lots. Equipped with 6 heavy-duty hydraulic dock levelers.
buildings.safety_notes: Cross-dock corridor speed limit capped at 8 mph. Full trailer wheel chocks mandatory before loading.

buildings.name: Building 3 — Tech Mezzanine
buildings.title: 3 · Tech Mezzanine
key_skus: SKU-3301 (Precision Semiconductor Wafers / IoT Sensor Modules, Cleanroom Bin CR-04)
buildings.description: Building 3 (Tech Mezzanine) is an ISO Class 7 cleanroom facility dedicated to micro-electronics, semiconductor components, and sensitive tech assemblies. Features conductive grounding floors and a dedicated 2.5-tonne vertical freight lift.
buildings.safety_notes: Antistatic wrist straps, ESD heel grounders, and ESD coats mandatory. Strictly no unshielded cardboard inside cleanroom.

buildings.name: Building 4 — Cold Vault
buildings.title: 4 · Cold Vault
key_skus: SKU-5520 (Insulin Glargine & Temperature-Sensitive Biologics, Chilled Rack C-02)
buildings.description: Building 4 (Cold Vault) provides temperature-controlled pharmaceutical cold-chain storage kept continuously at 2.0°C to 4.0°C. Equipped with dual-door interlocking airlocks, dual-redundant compressors, and real-time IoT temperature logging.
buildings.safety_notes: Door open time cannot exceed 3 minutes. Any temperature excursion above 5.0°C triggers immediate alert and supervisor notification (SOP-COLD-005).

buildings.name: Building 5 — Quarantine Yard
buildings.title: 5 · Quarantine Yard
buildings.dock_doors: Bay 11 Quarantine Dock & Hazmat Inspection Gate
key_skus: SKU-2045 (Heavy Duty Forklift Battery Lithium, Hazmat Bay B-12)
buildings.description: Building 5 (Quarantine Yard) is a restricted-access containment compound for defective customer returns, damaged shipments, lithium battery quarantine, and RMA triage. Features secondary chemical spill berms and acid neutralizing containment.
buildings.safety_notes: Restricted keycard access only. Level 2 PPE (chemical goggles, acid-resistant apron, nitrile gloves) required for hazardous inspection.

buildings.name: Building 6 — MHE Fleet Depot
buildings.title: 6 · Fleet Depot
buildings.description: Building 6 (MHE Fleet Depot) handles preventive maintenance, hydraulic inspections, and rapid turnaround for all material handling equipment. Contains 8 three-phase 480V fast-charging bays with active forced-air ventilation.
buildings.safety_notes: Continuous 24/7 exhaust fans must operate to prevent hydrogen gas accumulation during battery charging (SOP-MHE-008).

buildings.name: Building 7 — Gatehouse & Scale
buildings.title: 7 · Gatehouse & Scale
buildings.description: Building 7 (Gatehouse & Scale) is the primary access control point at Gate 1. Features a certified 60-tonne electronic weighbridge platform, automated license plate recognition (ALPR), carrier document inspection, and AGV guide dispatch.
buildings.safety_notes: All inbound trucks must stop on the weighbridge scale for gross tare weight logging before entering the campus (SOP-GATE-006).
